name: comp-579
title: Simple Responsive Navbar
blurb: Simple responsive navbar with underline active state.
description: Minimal header with logo, text nav links, and auth buttons. Active link underlined on desktop; mobile menu hidden behind popover.
use_when: You need a clean, fast-loading header without mega menus or search.
avoid_when: Complex multi-level navigation or heavy icon-based site structure.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Links are semantic.
